themes.summary: Many buyers say the knowledge base is clean, fast, and quick to set up and use.

hits.quote: It works well and doesn't overwhelm.
This was so quick to set up.
The interface is clean, fast, and much easier to manage than some of the larger help desk platforms I have tried.
It saves us time, and keeps our documentation beautifully organized.

themes.summary: Several reviewers note missing advanced controls like video embeds, article moving, and password or permission controls.

hits.quote: the ability to upload and embed videos directly, rather than having to host them elsewhere on platforms such as YouTube.
No way to move an article to a different category without recreating it.
Folder and article level sharing permissions would make this tool amazing ie for users added to platform.
i wish each user would have to enter a username and password to view content as this would make it very usable

themes.summary: Several buyers call it best-value and praise avoiding heavy subscription fees.

hits.quote: Overall, it’s one of the best-value knowledge base platforms we’ve come across.
It strips away the unnecessary complexity and does exactly what it promises.

themes.summary: Two reviewers report mobile display problems with subcategories and links in articles.

hits.quote: the knowledgebase doesn't scale correctly on mobile devices.
the mobile responsiveness is ok for now but becomes a bit challenging when their are links in articles
